fact: Truncating a timestamp to the date in local time moves late-evening events to the next day.
recommendation: Truncate in UTC and convert for display only.

fact: A byte-order sort puts accented names after every unaccented one.

content: A bare assignment from a failing command aborts the script under errexit.
implication: Capture the status at the call site.

fact.fact: A connection leaked on an error path exhausts the pool after a few hundred failures.
fact.recommendation: Release connections in a finally block.
